about: A USB port feeds the board through the USB-C receptacle; a one-cell LiPo of 500 mAh sits on the JST connector – nearly empty, half charged or full. SJ1 open as delivered (100 mA), soldered closed in the 500 mA mode. Values with 'note' are assumptions.

X2.note: USB 2.0 port and cable: 0.3 Ω source resistance (assumed, as edakit's example); with 5.1 kΩ Rd on CC1 and CC2 a USB-C source offers Default USB Power – 500 mA from a USB 2.0 port

low.note: Adafruit's 500 mAh LiPo (product 1578: PKCELL Li-Polymer 503035 500mAh 3.7V with PCM, specification QA.S.0228 ed. A, 2014-08-21): 3.0 V end of discharge, quick charge 1C = 500 mA at most, charge 0 … 45 °C; r 0.2 Ω with its protection circuit assumed – the specification gives none

nominal.note: the same cell at its nominal 3.7 V

full.note: the same cell at its charging voltage 4.2 V: the charger's constant-voltage end

100mA.about: as delivered: SJ1 open, R3 alone on PROG – 100 mA; the red LED lights while the cell charges

500mA.about: SJ1 soldered closed: R3 and R4 in parallel on PROG – the 500 mA mode

complete.about: the cell full: the charger holds 4.2 V and charges no more – the green LED lights
